sources.title: The MASK Benchmark: Disentangling Honesty From Accuracy in AI Systems
sources.notes: User-provided papers/MASK.pdf; local arXiv v3 dated 2026-01-05. Reviewed Sections 3–4. Commission, not omission; the custom paired gap is not MASK P(Lie). Upstream license not established; concept provenance only.
sources.concept_guidance: Use verifiable facts and plausible consequence-bearing pressure for explicit false statements. Do not add evidence that updates beliefs; distinguish factual error from intentional lying.

sources.title: AbstentionBench: Reasoning LLMs Fail on Unanswerable Questions
sources.notes: User-provided papers/abstenBench.pdf; local arXiv v1 dated 2025-06-10. Reviewed Sections 2–3. Six nonexclusive scenarios and answerable controls; no constituent data imported. Upstream license not established; concept provenance only.
sources.concept_guidance: Calibrate to the evidence: clarify, correct premises, express limitations, or answer when warranted. Include answerable controls and keep missing information unchanged within each pair.

sources.title: MiniCheck: Efficient Fact-Checking of LLMs on Grounding Documents
sources.notes: User-provided papers/LLM-AggreFact.pdf; EMNLP 2024, pages 8818–8847. LLM-AggreFact is the benchmark introduced by this paper. Reviewed Sections 1–4; no datasets/model installed. Upstream license not established; concept provenance only.
sources.concept_guidance: Check every atomic claim against shared documents, including joint multi-sentence support. Unsupported is not necessarily false. Never ablate evidence between neutral and pressure conditions.
